text:
Ravi: Heads-up: leadership wants a firm MVP cut for the May ship. We have three high-cost items on the plate. Need a call now.
Nora: Which items?
Ravi: 1) Embeddings persistence + long-tail cache; 2) Sync reranker for search relevancy; 3) Tenant-level cost UI (granular billing).
Clara: Customer pilots (Beacon + Orion) asked specifically for tenant billing and SSO. Billing is big for procurement.
Evan: Infra impact: embeddings persistence requires work on KV eviction and durable store. That's another full sprint.
Sam: Product POV: we can defer search reranker to v1 if we accept slightly lower relevance for early users. Billing UI can be a basic per-tenant toggle in Console for MVP.
Nora: So proposal: MVP = core inference + per-tenant billing toggle + simplified SSO. Defer embeddings persistence and async reranker to v1.
Ravi: That aligns with risk appetite. What about autoscaling? If we keep conservative scaling, latency spikes could hurt demos. Any mitigations?
Evan: Implement staged fallback routing to smaller quantized variants and enable prefix caching to mitigate demo spikes. Both are low-effort patches.
Clara: For sales, we must ensure procurement can see cost estimates. We'll expose an estimated monthly cost card in tenant settings.
Sam: Legal/legal-security need audit logs for Private pilots. That must be a gating requirement for Private deployments. Hosted can have a roadmap note.
Nora: Decision votes: Embeddings persistence -> v1 (vote: yes defer). Reranker -> v1 (defer). Billing UI (basic toggle + estimate) -> MVP (ship). Simplified SSO -> MVP. Fallback routing + prefix cache -> MVP. Audit logs for Private -> MUST.
Ravi: Noted. I'll update the milestone tracker: move embeddings persistence and reranker to milestone v1-2. Update release scope accordingly.
Evan: I'll drop a short infra runbook for fallback routing and prefix caching in eng-runtime channel.
Clara: I'll notify Beacon + Orion with the updated pilot expectations and call out audit logs for Private tenants.
Sam: I'll add the cost estimate card mock to the Console backlog.
release-bot: Reminder: release candidate cutoff in 6 days. Run `./tools/release/cut --candidate=mvp`
Ravi: Thanks everyone. Closing this decision thread and tagging the release epic. We'll reconvene if any blocker shows up before cutoff.
